limitations.note: Instead of correcting only the beverage-2 output codes at 2.5 and 3 yuan, the rewrite changed coin handling, sampled selection on the rising edge, committed credit on the falling edge, and changed how long outputs were held.
The testbench used the rewrite’s own edge-detection, simultaneous-coin, and change-queue rules as its oracle, so 10,000 passing cycles did not verify that the original FSM behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the first simulation invocation to be rejected before it ran, so the agent had to submit the testbench again.
The Git status check failed and yielded no information for the fix.
